---
# Generated by scripts/gen-workflows.py — do not edit by hand.
name: Kanbanauts — plan (codex)
description: Plan work for a GitHub issue (codex)
on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      issue_number:
        description: "Issue number"
        required: true
        type: number
    secrets:
      KANBANAUTS_AI_API_KEY:
        required: false

permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: read
  pull-requests: read
  actions: read
  id-token: write

timeout-minutes: 30
max-turns: 60

imports:
  - shared/engine-codex.md
  - shared/kanban-token.md
  - shared/kanban-report.md
  - shared/kanban-preflight.md
  - shared/kanban-setup-check.md
  - shared/prompts/plan.md

tools:
  github:
    mode: gh-proxy
    toolsets: [default]
  bash: ["*"]
  edit: false

env:
  GH_AW_KANBAN_PHASE: plan

run-name: agent plan #${{ inputs.issue_number }}

safe-outputs:
  add-comment:
    max: 1
    target: "*"
    github-token: ${{ steps.kanban.outputs.token }}
  create-issue: false
strict: true
---

# Kanbanauts plan

If `KANBANAUTS_SKIP` is `1`, do nothing and exit.
Otherwise plan the issue. Follow the imported prompt.
Call `kanban_report` with status `succeeded` (map from ready), `blocked`, `no_code`, or `failed`.
